The full spectrum of our

Services

Saptapadi means seven steps. Every wedding we plan moves through the same seven, so you always know where you stand.

01

Venue and destination

We visit shortlisted venues with you and handle contracts and costs.

02

Décor and design

Mandaps, florals and stages drawn up for your approval first.

03

Guest management

Invitations, RSVPs, stays and airport pickups in one list.

04

Catering and cuisine

Menu tastings and a caterer matched to your guest list.

05

Photo and films

Artists briefed on the moments your family cares about.

06

Entertainment

Sangeet choreography, DJs and live acts on a clear schedule.

07

Wedding-day control

A team on the ground, a minute-by-minute plan, one number to call.

One planner, from first call to farewell.

Common questions

Wedding planning FAQ

Why choose Saptapadi as your wedding planner in Pune?

We take a small number of weddings each season, so every couple gets our full attention, and we plan in seven clear steps.

Do you plan destination weddings outside Maharashtra?

Yes. We plan across India, including Goa, Rajasthan and Kerala, and at a few international destinations.

Can you work within a fixed budget?

Yes. Share your number on the first call and we build the plan to fit it.

How can I enquire?

Fill in the form below, message us on WhatsApp, or call. Meetings are by appointment.
